Range) |speed = 2 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision & Splash only) |flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Mark IV''' is the fourth vehicle that spawned from the [[Mecha Base]]. It spawns when the [[Mecha Base]] is at Level 4. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. The '''Mark IV''' has a spawnrate of 30 seconds. '''Mark IV''' can attack enemies with its turret and rocket launcher. ==Appearance== '''Mark IV''' is a tall light blue mechanized walker. It has neon blue parts to symbolize futurism. It has long mechanized legs and its operator sits at the top of the walker. The operator can shoot rockets from its quad launcher and bullets from its dual turrets. Bullets are belt-fed into the turrets. A windscreen protects the operator. The operator itself has tan skin, its torso and legs are black, and it wears white goggles. ==Strategy== *'''Mark IV''' can easily wipe out hordes of enemies due to its high DPS and rocket launcher. **Due to its long range, it can easily attack enemies from a long distance. *On maps with multiple plaths, only one '''Mark IV''' will spawn per Level 4 [[Mecha Base]]. It will go down a random path. *'''Mark IV''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Giant Boss]]. **However, '''Mark IV's''' ranged damage is still affected by enemies with [[defense]]. *As with other [[units]], the firerate and range of '''Mark IV''' cannot be boosted by the [[Commander]] or [[DJ Booth]], respectively. *'''Mark IV''' can cope well against enemies that deal damage to [[units]] with their abilities due to its high health. However, '''Mark IV''' is completely destroyed if the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] performs its ''Void Stomp'' attack. *The '''Mark IV''' can be very effective against hidden enemies, because of its high DPS and hidden detection. **However, it cannot detect flying enemies. It also cannot collide with ghost enemies. ==Trivia== *'''Mark IV''' replaced the [[XR900]], which existed before [[Hardcore Testing BETA]]. *'''Mark IV''' was made exclusive in [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] as it is only used to test units in [[Hardcore Testing BETA]]. *The goggles worn by the operator inside '''Mark IV''' are a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|833772989|Laser Spec Special Forces Goggles}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *'''Mark IV''', alongside [[Mark V]], used to have the highest range in the game, totalling at 100. *'''Mark IV''' is mislabelled as [[Mark III]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''28 August 2020''' -
